detail:
Full summary: Local plugin updated to 1.25.0 in BOTH user and project scopes via claude plugin update (verified: installed_plugins.json both at 1.25.0/429a2d2, cached bundle carries the 2.7.0 server). Applies on next session restart. The field-repo half of the outstanding need (send memo, upgrade other machine) remains open
Findings: claude plugin update <plugin> --scope user|project is the sanctioned per-scope update path — no hand-editing of installed_plugins.json needed; each scope updates independently and both must be run (stale project pin shadows user scope)
